# Tool registry

**Generated by `scripts/gen_tool_docs.py` from `tools/registry.py` + `tools/ast_facts.py` - do not hand-edit.** Run `python scripts/gen_tool_docs.py` after adding or removing a tool; `tests/test_tool_registry.py` fails the build if this file drifts from the source it was generated from.

**51 tools, 7 categories.**

## Creation (15)

| Tool | Description | Route | Risk | Mutates model | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_detail_line` | Create a detail line in a Revit view for annotation purposes. | `POST /create_detail_line/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_duct` | Create a duct in the Revit model between two points. | `POST /create_duct/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_grid` | Create grid lines for the structural layout of a building. | `POST /create_grid/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_level` | Create building levels (floor elevations) in Revit. | `POST /create_level/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_line_based_element` | Create walls, beams, and other line-based building elements in Revit. | `POST /create_line/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_mep_system` | Create a mechanical or piping system and optionally add elements to it. | `POST /create_mep_system/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_pipe` | Create a pipe in the Revit model between two points. | `POST /create_pipe/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_room` | Create a room in the Revit model at a specified level. | `POST /create_room/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_room_separation` | Create room separation lines to define room boundaries. | `POST /create_room_separation/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_schedule` | Create a schedule (quantity takeoff view) for a specific element category. | `POST /create_schedule/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_sheet` | Create a drawing sheet in Revit for construction documentation. | `POST /create_sheet/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_structural_framing` | Create structural beams and framing elements in Revit. | `POST /create_framing/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_surface_based_element` | Create floors, roofs, ceilings, and other surface-based building elements. | `POST /create_surface/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `create_view` | Create a new view in the Revit model. | `POST /create_view/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `place_family` | Place a family instance at a specified location in the Revit model | `POST /place_family/` | additive | yes | documented |

## Query (12)

| Tool | Description | Route | Risk | Mutates model | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_current_view_elements` | Get all elements visible in the currently active view in Revit. | `GET /current_view_elements/` | read | no | read_only |
| `get_current_view_info` | Get detailed information about the currently active view in Revit. | `GET /current_view_info/` | read | no | read_only |
| `get_element_properties` | Get all properties and parameters of a Revit element. | `GET /element_properties/<element_id>` | read | no | read_only |
| `get_revit_model_info` | Get comprehensive information about the current Revit model | `GET /model_info/` | read | no | read_only |
| `get_revit_status` | Check if the Revit MCP API is active and responding | `GET /status/` | read | no | read_only |
| `get_revit_view` | Export a specific Revit view as an image | `GET /get_view/<view_name>` | read | no | read_only |
| `get_selected_elements` | Get details of elements currently selected in the Revit UI. | `GET /selected_elements/` | read | no | read_only |
| `list_category_parameters` | Get available parameters for elements in a category | `POST /list_category_parameters/` | read | no | read_only |
| `list_families` | Get a flat list of available family types in the current Revit model | `GET /list_families/` | read | no | read_only |
| `list_family_categories` | Get a list of all family categories in the current Revit model | `GET /list_family_categories/` | read | no | read_only |
| `list_levels` | Get a list of all levels in the current Revit model | `GET /list_levels/` | read | no | read_only |
| `list_revit_views` | Get a list of all exportable views in the current Revit model | `GET /list_views/` | read | no | read_only |

## Editing (9)

| Tool | Description | Route | Risk | Mutates model | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clear_colors` | Clear color overrides for elements in a category | `POST /clear_colors/` | modifying | yes | documented |
| `color_splash` | Color elements in a category based on parameter values | `POST /color_splash/` | modifying | yes | documented |
| `delete_elements` | Delete one or more elements from the Revit model. | `POST /delete_elements/` | destructive | yes | documented |
| `modify_element` | Modify parameter values on a Revit element. | `POST /modify_element/` | modifying | yes | documented |
| `set_active_view` | Switch the active view in Revit to the specified view. | `POST /set_active_view/` | modifying | yes | documented |
| `set_parameter` | Set a single parameter value on a Revit element. | `POST /set_parameter/` | modifying | yes | documented |
| `tag_elements` | Tag elements with annotation symbols in a view. | `POST /tag_elements/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `tag_walls` | Tag all untagged walls in the current Revit view. | `POST /tag_walls/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `transform_elements` | Move, copy, rotate, or mirror elements in the Revit model. | `POST /transform_elements/` | modifying | yes | documented |

## Analysis (8)

| Tool | Description | Route | Risk | Mutates model | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ai_element_filter` | Filter and find Revit elements by category, type, visibility, and spatial bounds. | `POST /ai_filter/` | read | no | read_only |
| `analyze_model_statistics` | Analyze the Revit model and return element counts grouped by category. | `GET /model_statistics/` | read | no | read_only |
| `analyze_relationships` | Inspect what one or more elements are connected to, read-only. | `POST /analyze_relationships/` | read | no | documented |
| `check_clashes` | Detect hard clashes (geometric interferences) between model elements. | `POST /clash_check/` | read | no | read_only |
| `export_room_data` | Export data for all rooms defined in the Revit model. | `GET /room_data/` | read | no | read_only |
| `get_material_quantities` | Get material quantities (areas and volumes) from the Revit model. | `POST /material_quantities/` | read | no | read_only |
| `preview_delete_impact` | Preview what deleting elements would actually remove — nothing is deleted. | `POST /preview_delete_impact/` | read | no | documented |
| `validate_design` | Check rooms against external design standards (read-only). | `POST /validate_design/` | read | no | documented |

## Documentation (2)

| Tool | Description | Route | Risk | Mutates model | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_dimensions` | Create dimension annotations for elements in the current view. | `POST /create_dimensions/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `export_document` | Export a Revit view or sheet to PDF or image format. | `POST /export_document/` | additive | yes | documented |

## Interop & persistence (4)

| Tool | Description | Route | Risk | Mutates model | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `export_ifc` | Export the Revit model to IFC format. | `POST /export_ifc/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `link_file` | Link or import an external file into the Revit model. | `POST /link_file/` | additive | yes | documented |
| `load_family` | Load a Revit family (.rfa file) from disk into the active document. | `POST /load_family/` | additive | yes | out_of_scope |
| `save_document` | Save the active Revit document to disk so work persists. | `POST /save_document/` | additive | no | documented |

## Advanced (1)

| Tool | Description | Route | Risk | Mutates model | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `execute_revit_code` | Execute IronPython code directly in Revit context. | `POST /execute_code/` | destructive | yes | documented |

Full contract text (preconditions, post-conditions, verification method, known limits) for every documented mutating tool lives in [operation-contracts.md](operation-contracts.md). A `contract` value starting `known_gap` or `out_of_scope` links back to `tools/registry.py`'s own comment for the reason.
